title: Lilliput Lane The Tailor L2054 Victorian Shops Collection 1997 Handmade England
conditionDescription: Small chips to the awning edge, shopfront trim and base corners - shown in the close-ups. No box or deed.
descriptionText:
Lilliput Lane "The Tailor" (L2054) from the Victorian Shops Collection - handmade in England, 1997 (retired 1999). Three-story stone tailor's shop with the green shopfront, arched display window with jackets and fabric bolts, a tailor figure at the door, side cottage with luggage by the door, and cobbled base. Green felt underside with the original Lilliput Lane label and barcode (72.388.463). About 5 inches tall.

No box or deed - figurine only.

Condition: Pre-owned with a few small chips to the paint/resin - most noticeable on the awning edge, the shopfront trim, and the base corners (see close-up photos). Otherwise clean with good color. Please review all 12 photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
